name: Yasho Industries Ltd
title: Yasho Industries Ltd - 541167 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 volume-led growth with utilisation above 60% in FY26 and a target of over 75% in FY27; management guides FY27 volume growth of 35-45% and FY28 revenue of INR1,500 crores, but working capital and import delays are watch items.

utilisation.quote: Our plant facilities operated at above 60% utilization in FY '26

capex.quote: In FY27, we are looking at about INR125 crores capex that will be purely done at the Pakhajan.

triggers.label: Utilisation >60% → target >75% FY27
triggers.quote: we target over 75% utilization in FY '27, supporting EBITDA margin expansion

triggers.label: FY27 volume growth 35-45%
triggers.quote: volumes are between 35% to 45%, volume growth also will happen in FY27

triggers.label: Working capital days 215 → 190
triggers.quote: We are broadly down to 190 days today.

guidance.quote: we target over 75% utilization in FY '27
we are expecting at least 2%, 3% higher EBITDA compared to the what we had
anything between 40% to 42% should be the right guidance
For FY '27, the company has planned a capex of INR125 crores, which will be completely funded through internal accruals.
our comfort zone will be in the 2.5x
we would like to bring it down to 175, 170 in the next 6 to 12 months

red_flags.label: Working capital ~190 days, down from 215
red_flags.quote: We are broadly down to 190 days today.

red_flags.label: Import delays 8-12 weeks, export transit 60-70 days
red_flags.quote: at times it's taking more than 8 to 12 weeks to get the product

red_flags.label: Price-up only from late March; earlier pricing under pressure
red_flags.quote: Earlier, the price growth was not there.

evasions.quote: we will always talk about the Yasho level rather than I'll talk about the individual capacity level
I think all segments are doing quite good for us.
I cannot get too much into that.
Honestly speaking, I don't know what is my current capacity.
